name: build-world-raster
description: Offline tool that renders assets/world-raster.jpg as a painterly hand-drawn-style map straight from assets/game-map.json's real cell/biome/elevation/river/state data — vector-rendered then blurred for soft blending, with crisp coastline/rivers/trees/hachures on top. Not part of the game's runtime — see context/roadmap.md.
